verses.en: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
verses.pt: No restante, meus irmãos, alegrai-vos no Senhor. Não me é incômodo escrever as mesmas coisas, e isso é para a vossa segurança.
verses.en_web: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
verses.en_bbe: For the rest, my brothers, be glad in the Lord. Writing the same things to you is no trouble to me, and for you it is safe.

verses.en: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
verses.pt: Cuidado com os cães! Cuidado com os que operam o mal! Cuidado com a mutilação!
verses.en_web: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the false circumcision.
verses.en_bbe: Be on the watch against dogs, against the workers of evil, against those of the circumcision:

verses.en: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
verses.pt: Pois a circuncisão somos nós, que servimos a Deus pelo Espírito, orgulhamo-nos em Cristo Jesus, e não confiamos na carne.
verses.en_web: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
verses.en_bbe: For we are the circumcision, who give worship to God and have glory in Jesus Christ, and have no faith in the flesh:

verses.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
verses.pt: Embora eu também tenho como confiar na carne. Se outro alguém pensa que pode confiar na carne, ainda mais eu:
verses.en_web: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
verses.en_bbe: Even though I myself might have faith in the flesh: if any other man has reason to have faith in the flesh, I have more:

verses.en: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.pt: circuncidado ao oitavo dia, da descendência de Israel, da tribo de Benjamim, hebreu de hebreus; segundo a lei, fariseu;
verses.en_web: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
verses.en_bbe: Being given circumcision on the eighth day, of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; in relation to the law, a Pharisee:

verses.en: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.pt: segundo o zelo, perseguidor da Igreja; segundo a justiça que há na lei, irrepreensível.
verses.en_web: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
verses.en_bbe: In bitter hate I was cruel to the church; I kept all the righteousness of the law to the last detail.

verses.en: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
verses.pt: Mas o que para mim era ganho considerei como perda, por causa de Cristo.
verses.en_web: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
verses.en_bbe: But those things which were profit to me, I gave up for Christ.

verses.en: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
verses.pt: E, na verdade, considero também todas as coisas como perda, por causa da superioridade de conhecer a Cristo Jesus, meu Senhor. Por ele aceitei perder todas essas coisas, e as considero como dejetos, a fim de que eu possa ganhar a Cristo;
verses.en_web: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
verses.en_bbe: Yes truly, and I am ready to give up all things for the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, which is more than all: for whom I have undergone the loss of all things, and to me they are less than nothing, so that I may have Christ as my reward,

verses.en: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
verses.pt: e que eu seja achado nele, não tendo a minha justiça proveniente da Lei, mas sim a que é pela fé em Cristo, a justiça da parte de Deus pela fé;
verses.en_web: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith;
verses.en_bbe: And be seen in him, not having my righteousness which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

verses.en: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
verses.pt: para eu conhecer a ele, assim como o poder de sua ressurreição e a comunhão em seus sofrimentos, tornando-me conforme a ele em sua morte;
verses.en_web: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death;
verses.en_bbe: That I may have knowledge of him, and of the power of his coming back from the dead, and a part with him in his pains, becoming like him in his death;

verses.en: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
verses.pt: para que, de alguma maneira, eu alcance a ressurreição dos mortos.
verses.en_web: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: If in any way I may have the reward of life from the dead.

verses.en: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Não que eu já a tenha obtido, ou que já seja perfeito; mas sigo a fim de alcançar aquilo para o qual eu também fui alcançado por Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Not as if I had even now got the reward or been made complete: but I go on in the hope that I may come to the knowledge of that for which I was made the servant of Christ Jesus.

verses.en: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verses.pt: Irmãos, não considero como se já a tivesse obtido; mas uma coisa faço: esqueço as coisas que ficam para trás, e avanço para as que estão adiante,
verses.en_web: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,
verses.en_bbe: Brothers, it is clear to me that I have not come to that knowledge; but one thing I do, letting go those things which are past, and stretching out to the things which are before,

verses.en: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: e prossigo para o alvo, ao prêmio do chamado de cima, de Deus em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: I go forward to the mark, even the reward of the high purpose of God in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
verses.pt: Por isso, todos nós que somos maduros, tenhamos essa mesma mentalidade; e se em algo pensais de maneira diferente, Deus também vos revelará isso.
verses.en_web: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
verses.en_bbe: Then let us all, who have come to full growth, be of this mind: and if in anything you are of a different mind, even this will God make clear to you:

verses.en: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
verses.pt: Porém, naquilo a que já chegamos, andemos conforme a mesma regra, e tenhamos a mesma mentalidade.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule. Let us be of the same mind.
verses.en_bbe: Only, as far as we have got, let us be guided by the same rule.

verses.en: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
verses.pt: Sede meus imitadores, irmãos, e observai atentamente os que assim andam, como o exemplo que tendes em nós;
verses.en_web: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
verses.en_bbe: Brothers, take me as your example, and take note of those who are walking after the example we have given.

verses.en: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.pt: pois, como muitas vezes eu vos disse, e agora também digo chorando, muitos andam como inimigos da cruz de Cristo.
verses.en_web: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
verses.en_bbe: For there are those, of whom I have given you word before, and do so now with sorrow, who are haters of the cross of Christ;

verses.en: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
verses.pt: O fim deles é a perdição. O Deus deles é o ventre, e têm orgulho do que deviam se envergonhar. Eles se importam mais com as coisas terrenas.
verses.en_web: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
verses.en_bbe: Whose end is destruction, whose god is the stomach, and whose glory is in their shame, whose minds are fixed on the things of the earth.

verses.en: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.pt: Mas nós somos cidadãos dos céus, de onde também esperamos um Salvador, o Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.en_bbe: For our country is in heaven; from where the Saviour for whom we are waiting will come, even the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.en: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
verses.pt: Ele transformará o nosso degradante corpo, para que seja conforme o seu corpo glorioso, segundo a operação do seu poder de sujeitar para si todas as coisas.
verses.en_web: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
verses.en_bbe: By whom this poor body of ours will be changed into the image of the body of his glory, in the measure of the working by which he is able to put all things under himself.
